title: kg_sync.heldout_checks selects the held-out file for a .md under an underscore directory, such as _retrieval/notes.md or _snapshots/README.md
goal: kg_sync.heldout_checks in _tools/kg_sync.py counts as an article only a root's <domain>/<slug>.md whose every path part below the root has no leading underscore, so a root's _retrieval/notes.md or _snapshots/README.md selects nothing while a changed article still selects its root's lookup_heldout.csv; pure-function asserts in the existing test_heldout_reword_is_refused_at_the_gate of test_sync_e2e.py prove it (no new test id)

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kg_sync;r=[p for p in ('kb/public/_retrieval/notes.md','kb/public/_snapshots/README.md') if kg_sync.heldout_checks([p])];print(r);sys.exit(1 if r else 0)
